title: Physical Diaries
tagline: Adds diary books to NPC's inventories to read SkyrimNet diaries in game
description:
# Physical Diaries
A companion mod for SkyrimNet that turns the AI-generated diary entries written by NPCs into actual books you can find and read in the world.
## Features
Each NPC that writes diary entries will have a physical diary book in their inventory. The entries are formatted by in-game date and use a handwriting font. New entries are automatically added to the NPCs latest volume. When a diary fills up, it seals itself and a fresh volume begins. Sealed volumes stay in the NPC's inventory alongside newer ones, giving you a complete history to read. The number of entries per volume can be configured in the MCM.

Pressing Home (default) in a diary shows a table of contents with that diary's entries, listed by date. Selecting an entry jumps directly to that page. This feature requires **Ink & Quill**.
### Theft & Return
Stealing an NPC's diary has consequences. The NPC will be aware that their diary is missing when writing a new entry. Returning the diary before their next entry clears the record and they'll never know it was taken. Taking a follower's diary by trading items will trigger a response making them aware that you took it.
### Automatic Writing
Optionally, Physical Diaries will randomly select a configurable number of NPCs (3 default) to write a diary every day, based on how active their day was. You can also whitelist specific NPCs to always write a new entry every day. Configured in the MCM.
### Player Writing
You can now write your own diary entries by hand and have them registered by SkyrimNet. Craft a blank journal with **1** leather and **2** rolls of paper at a tanning rack or purchase one from a general goods merchant. This feature requires **Ink & Quill**.

Keybinds:
- F3 (default) starts editing and saves when finished
- F8 (default) begins a new entry
- F10 (default) tear out an entry to delete it from SkyrimNet
### Localization
Physical Diaries supports all 9 languages officially supported by Skyrim.
## Requirements
- SkyrimNet Beta 26+
- SkyUI
- SKSE
- Address Library
- powerofthree's Tweaks
- Ink & Quill (optional)
